model.pool: Each team is 8 girls from that school's tryout in that grade. Five teams is a pool of 40. One team is a pool of 8. 4th grade, 5/6, and Cadet are separate pools.
model.slices: A takes the best 8, then B, then C. Teams in the same letter share a slice and start equal. A grade with no letter starts every team at 1500.
model.scale: A one-team school starts at 1500. The best 8 of a 32-girl pool start 325 points higher, and the bottom 8 start 325 lower. The middle of a big pool starts near a one-team school.
model.update: A 2-1 between even teams is ±24 points. A 2-0 is ±36. League and tournament games both count.
model.sos: SOS is the average final rating of the opponents played.
